I am a young man here in Mbeya, and this small plot of beans is just a small piece of my land. Beans are legumes, so they fix their own nitrogen — I do not waste my little money on urea or DAP for them. I will use seed I saved from last season because improved bean seed is expensive and hard to find at the shop. The rains here in the Southern Highlands are usually good, so I do not need to irrigate, and on such a small plot my family and I can manage the weeding and harvesting ourselves.
